mechanism: Only replace the free Wiki residual execution with confidence in [0,1] times the bounded supported case proposal; same typed case inputs, hidden layers, parameter count and initialization. The proposal is rebased to the actual frozen common base. Exact zero when case proposal/support is zero; no direction reversal.
train_side_evidence: Saved v7 donor-only calibration: Base MAE/RMSE 189.275730/252.547942, direct CaseReadout 185.841766/250.270708, free Wiki 189.678919/253.209458. Free Wiki reverses 25.76% of supported case directions, violates the base-case convex hull on 40.91%, and changes all eight case-zero points. Selection direct cases are NOT jointly better, so anchoring is a falsifiable inductive-bias hypothesis, not a proven fix.
numerical_base: Reuse the exact v7 numerical gate and its saved transformed train packs; no numerical gate refit, backbone refit, label/scaler changes or old checkpoint retraining
fit: Identical v7 saved donor1-5 memory+early packs; memory-unavailable points remain exact-zero and cannot teach an unsupported correction
selection: Identical v7 middle-third 115-window epoch-selection pack, same MAE/RMSE jointly non-worse rule and exact epoch0 fallback; no outer selection
benefit_calibration: Identical v7 last-third 110-window fresh-certificate pack; all newly computed outputs get a new certificate bound to their own checkpoint, model-source hash and the actual common numerical gate ID. These periods have been development-inspected: no independent confirmation claim.
controls: Reuse frozen v7 free Wiki and zero-memory trained checkpoints/predictions/certificates without retraining. Same fit/selection/label budget, parameters and optimizer; the activation/proposal constraint is the sole intended method difference from free Wiki. This is not a pure removal of semantic tokens.
additional_diagnostic_control: Fixed direct case proposal with confidence=1, not a searched epoch or threshold; compute its own training-only certificate and report both raw and selective outcomes
primary_success: CaseAnchoredWikiSelective must jointly improve MAE/RMSE over CertifiedNumeric/Persistence, frozen FreeWikiSelective and ZeroMemorySelective; compare against DirectCaseSelective to test value of learned confidence. Also report raw comparisons without promoting them after outer inspection.
budget: One new fold1 seed2024 20-epoch anchored expert only. No completed control retraining or automatic fold/seed expansion.
resource_policy: Adaptive current resource utility: no sharing cap/delay when alone; limited process-local allocation and cooperative yielding when other GPU compute jobs exist; never stop or reconfigure other users.
forbidden: claiming a temporal guarantee from a small correlated calibration period
limitations: One historically inspected development fold. Direction constraints can hurt when case directions are wrong. Small support and temporal drift may still lead to full abstention. Confidence near zero may underfit; do not add follow-up weight/LR searches within this protocol. No novelty or Wiki contribution is established merely by adding this head.
